articles.headline: Rose urges humility after Bournemouth rout Milan as Amorim rues red card
articles.description: Marco Rose said his Bournemouth team will stay humble after they dominated AC Milan 3-0 in the Europa League while Ruben Amorim said the match was over as a contest for his team after Mike Maignan's red card in the first half.
